title: Library bindings for bare reads, paren-less calls and function-result receivers
summary: Bare reads of library vars (Application), paren-less library calls and members on a library function result bind to refs.external_target
intro: Read this when usages shows a library name such as Application as name-only, when a paren-less call of a library function is missing from purity or caller answers, or when a member called on a library function's result (Printer.Canvas, a var inferred from it) has no library target. Since 1.51.1 the resolve pass binds all three and marks a read with refs.external_kind value, parenless-call or proc-value.
